topic: Retina Detachment: The Warning Signs You Have 24 Hours to Catch

script_gate.verdict: PASS — hook clear, every segment advances

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.vo: Retina detachment strikes fast: 24 hours to save your sight or lose it forever.
beats.caption: RETINA DETACHMENT

beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.vo: Vikram, I see flashes and floaters. My friend says that's just aging, right?
beats.caption: FLASHES & FLOATERS

beats.speaker: VIKRAM
beats.vo: Not always. Watch for these 4 red flags: sudden shower of floaters, new flashes, a shadow creeping in, or vision loss.
beats.caption: 4 RED FLAGS

beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.vo: Whoa, four flags? What if I spot one? I've got all week, right?
beats.caption: TIME WINDOW

beats.speaker: VIKRAM
beats.vo: No. You have exactly 24 hours. Remember the 24-0-0 rule: 24 hours max, 0 delay, 0 doubt. Go to ER now.
beats.caption: 24 HOURS MAX

beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.vo: Save this to save your sight. Follow for more. And remember, flashes aren't always harmless...
beats.caption: SAVE YOUR SIGHT
